assumptions: The dword at state + 0x10 is loaded in every phase-B path but never read afterwards; it is recorded as loaded-but-unused, not as an input to any outcome.
The producer result in the null-counter path is adjusted by the + 0x38 field and then never stored or returned; it is recorded as computed-but-unconsumed.

The known slot values below are the RELATIVE relocation addends of their GOT slots in the file; at runtime the loader writes those addends into the slots, so the comparisons in the routine read exactly these values.
The kinds of the state object, the inner object, the delegate and the waiter at source level are not pinned; only field offsets and the dispatch rules are.
Arithmetic on the counter is 64-bit wrapping add/subtract, matching the add/sub forms in the excerpt.

delegate.rule: when the slot-0x98 value equals the known producer, the producer call is slot 0x98 of the delegate instead of the slot value itself

handler.known_value_note: the known handler's own 25-byte body is the byte check at waiter + 0x20 against 2 followed by the slot-0xd8 tail dispatch; the routine's known-handler path duplicates that body inline instead of calling it
handler.rule: when the slot-0xc8 value differs from the known handler, call it directly with the waiter and return; when it equals the known handler, return if the byte at waiter + 0x20 is at most 2, else tail-dispatch slot 0xd8 of the waiter

producer.rule: when the slot-0x98 value differs from the known producer, call the slot value itself with the inner object; when it equals the known producer, call slot 0x98 of the delegate

exits.condition: counter pointer null and flag at state + 0x21 zero
counter pointer null, flag at state + 0x21 nonzero, handler differs from the known handler
exits.form: plain return after the direct handler call

exits.condition: counter pointer null or not, phase B reached, handler equals the known handler and the waiter byte is at most 2
counter pointer null or not, phase B reached, handler equals the known handler and the waiter byte is above 2
exits.form: tail dispatch to waiter vtable slot 0xd8

exits.condition: phase A completes and flag at state + 0x21 zero

accumulate.store: counter = old counter + producer result - field at state + 0x38

phase_a.counter_pointer: state + 0x18, null skips phase A entirely

extra_subtract.store: counter -= field at state + 0x28, second store to the same slot

phase_a.gate: runs only when the counter pointer is non-null

replace.store: counter = producer result - field at state + 0x38

phase_b.gate: runs only when the flag byte at state + 0x21 is nonzero

routine.inner_object: state + 0x00, first qword of the state
routine.returns: nothing (the counter slot is written in place; the routine's own return value is residue)
routine.writes: only the counter slot at (state + 0x18), at most twice; nothing else is written
